tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List all affiliate programs available. Use this first if no program has been selected yet, then use select_program to choose one.

tools.name: select_program
tools.description: Select which affiliate program to work with for this session.

program_id.description: The program ID to select (from list_programs)

created_lte.description: End of period for counts (ISO 8601 date)

tools.description: List affiliates/partners with name, email, status, and referral stats.

program_id.description: Program ID (uses default if not provided)

limit.description: Number of results to return (max 100, default 20)

starting_after.description: Cursor for next page: return results after this record ID

ending_before.description: Cursor for previous page: return results before this record ID

created_lte.description: Filter partners created on or before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-12-31')
